method: opaque-alpha figure box + solid-dark fill. The ink contour shares the marking's warm brown, so the dark mask is eroded by 9 px (half the 3-4 px master contour at this size) before components are measured; what remains is paint area, not line. Band height and edges are reported as percentages of the front view's figure height.
why: ART-BIBLE.md §3 previously required dark socks to the elbow. No plate carries that; the longest dark band on the authority is the one measured here.

sheet.neck_pinch_note: the front view's widest row is its feet, so the neck-pinch estimate is not meaningful on the sheet

not_claimed: No wrist, elbow or ankle joint is detected. The arm merges with the torso on every plate in this set, so no wrist-to-elbow ratio is claimed from a silhouette.
